# lokalise_project (Resource)

A Lokalise project. The base language is created with the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lokalise_project" "example" {
  name              = "My App"
  description       = "iOS + Android strings"
  base_language_iso = "en"

  # deletion_protection defaults to true: `terraform destroy` fails instead of
  # deleting the project (and all its translations). Set it to false and apply
  # before destroying or replacing the project.
  # deletion_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_language_iso` (String) Language code of the project's base language, created with the project. Changing it forces a new project.
- `name` (String) Project name.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When `true` (the default), destroying this resource fails instead of deleting the project. Set to `false` and apply before destroying. Imported projects get `true`.
- `description` (String) Project description.
- `project_type` (String) Project type, e.g. `localization_files` or `marketing`. When omitted, Lokalise's default (`localization_files`) is used on create, and an existing or imported project keeps its type. Changing it forces a new project.
- `team_id` (Number) Team to create the project in. Defaults to the API token user's current team. Changing it forces a new project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Lokalise project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lokalise_project.example <project_id>
```
